# Vendored Pojlib snapshot

This directory is a directly editable vendored snapshot of Pojlib.

- Upstream: https://github.com/QuestCraftPlusPlus/Pojlib
- Upstream branch: QuestCraft-6.0.0
- Upstream commit: c6566d540a3ef530017f99b59f24d38121e3a5df
- License: LGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE in this directory)

VoxyQuest intentionally stores these files directly instead of using a Git submodule so launcher/runtime integration changes can be made in this repository.
